post.description: Rules 1.3 and 1.4. Answers a short access token (15 minutes) and starts a session with a rotating refresh token (30 days). On the web the refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie; a native app sends `x-auth-transport: token` and receives it in the body. info.title: App API
info.description:
The HTTP API of the app.

- **Money** is always an integer number of cents (`amountCents`).
- **Days** are dates without a time, `YYYY-MM-DD`. "Today" and the limits of a month follow the time zone of the person's preferences.
- **Errors** have one shape, `{ statusCode, code, message, details? }`. `code` is stable (`NOTE.NOT_FOUND`): branch on it, never on the message.
- **Lists** are paginated: `page` and `limit` in, `{ results, meta }` out.
- **Ownership**: everything belongs to the signed-in person. Someone else's resource answers 404.
- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (15 minutes). Renew it with `POST /auth/refresh`.
